diagnostics.message: aws_cloudfront_distribution.default declares `depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket.origin]`, but it already depends on that bucket implicitly: origin.domain_name uses local.bucket_domain_name, which resolves through local.origin_bucket / local.origin_bucket_options to aws_s3_bucket.origin[0] (and the same local is referenced throughout the distribution). Terraform therefore already orders the distribution after the bucket, so the explicit depends_on is redundant.
